records.english: Lift the rifle, the machine gun; bring your motherland to life.

records.english: May lightning fall upon your head! (A common Kashmiri way of berating)
Nothing will be achieved now by killing oneself over this
records.kashmiri: یَتھ پؠٹھ پان مارنہٕ سٟتؠ اَنٛدِ نہٕ وۄنؠ کینٛہہ

records.english: Shed the pheran, become a soldier

excludedEnglish: Lord! If abandoning mother Sita is necessary, then why did we fight the war? Then why did Jatayu die? Then why did so many great braves from both sides die?
